taxonomy:
Here is a simple single-depth hierarchical taxonomy of grid-based logic games, with each game placed into exactly one of 7 categories and no duplicates:

## 1. Number Placement and Region Logic
- Fillomino
- Shikaku
- Sudoku
- Ripple Effect
- Hitori
- Choco Banana
- Double Choco
- Five Cells
- Evolomino
- Juosan
- Nansuke
- Nuritwin

## 2. Path and Loop Logic
- Slitherlink
- Masyu
- Hashiwokakero
- Numberlink
- Dotchi-Loop
- Mid-loop
- Yajilin
- Hebi
- Satogaeri
- Nagareru
- Pencils

## 3. Shading and Unshading Logic
- Akari
- Heyawake
- Kurodoko
- Nurikabe
- Kurotto
- Nurimeizu
- Nurimisaki
- Norinori
- Usowan
- Tilepaint
- Moon-or-Sun

## 4. Polyomino and Shape Placement
- LITS
- Shakashaka
- Sashigane
- Chained Block
- Makaro
- Sto-stone

## 5. Connectivity and Partition Logic
- Chained Block
- Suraromu
- Yosenabe
- Choco Banana
- Double Choco

## 6. Directional and Arrow Logic
- Yajilin
- Nurimisaki
- Makaro
- Satogaeri
- Nagareru
- Pencils

## 7. Miscellaneous Grid Logic
- Choco Banana
- Double Choco
- Evolomino
- Juosan
- Nansuke
- Sto-stone
- Suraromu

If you want, I can also redo this so that each game appears in exactly one category with no overlaps.
